item.title: CDC to send disease detective to Pennsylvania amid 4,400 US measles cases
item.description: Over 4,400 measles cases reported in the U.S. as the CDC plans to deploy a disease detective to Pennsylvania.

item.title: Georgia Senate and governor races test Trump's political influence
item.description: Trump plays a significant role in Georgia's races, with Democrats working to tie GOP opponents to his unpopular economic policies.

item.title: Feds probe suspicious letters sent to election officials and lawmakers
item.description: Federal investigators are examining suspicious letters containing unknown substances mailed to state election officials and lawmakers.

item.title: Bend, Oregon school shooting: hero who stopped suspect identified by family
item.description: Three children and one teacher died after a shooter forced his way into a Bend, Oregon elementary school and opened fire, authorities said.
